description.p: Inspect physical disks, SMART health, mdadm arrays, band layout and synchronization progress through the SHR-RS schema-versioned status command.

Create and expand SHR/SHR-2 groups through a guided wizard, and run scrub, disk replacement, recompression, snapshots, schedule installation and destroy from the operations panel. Destructive actions require a dry-run preview and typed confirmation, and run only with administrative access.
